overview: ESPO is a sequence-level reinforcement learning framework for diffusion large language models (dLLMs) that treats entire sequence generation as a single action, uses the ELBO as a tractable proxy for intractable sequence log-likelihood, and incorporates per-token normalization of importance ratios and a k2 KL-divergence estimator to achieve stable large-scale training on reasoning tasks.

modules.name: Diffusion Forward Process & ELBO Computation
modules.description: Implements the masked diffusion forward process that corrupts clean sequences by replacing tokens with mask tokens according to a continuous masking ratio or discrete number of masked tokens, and computes both the continuous-time ELBO (Eq. 2) and its lower-variance discrete variant (Eq. 3) as variational lower bounds for the intractable sequence log-likelihood.

modules.name: Token-Level ELBO Decomposition
modules.description: Computes per-token contributions to the ELBO (L_k^theta in Eq. 5), which serves as a heuristic proxy for autoregressive conditional probabilities in token-level baselines. This module is needed for implementing token-level comparison methods and for summing token contributions within the sequence-level ratio.

modules.name: Sequence-Level Importance Ratio with Length Normalization
modules.description: Constructs the stabilized sequence-level importance ratio (Eq. 8) by exponentiating the per-token-normalized ELBO difference between the current and old policies. This replaces the unstable raw ratio (Eq. 6) and ensures the magnitude does not scale catastrophically with sequence length.

modules.name: KL-Divergence Estimators Suite
modules.description: Implements the three KL-divergence estimators under ELBO log-parameterization: the k1 estimator (log-ratio, Eq. 28), the k2 estimator (squared log-difference, Eq. 10/30), and the k3 estimator (exponential form, Eq. 9/26). Includes gradient property verification showing k2 yields unbiased forward-KL gradients while k3 yields reverse-KL gradients.

modules.name: ESPO Clipped Objective
modules.description: Assembles the complete ESPO optimization objective (Eq. 7) combining the stabilized sequence-level importance ratio with PPO-style clipping, group-relative advantage weighting, and the k2 KL-divergence regularizer. Supports both the clipped surrogate term and the unclipped baseline for the min operation.

modules.name: Group Sampling & Relative Advantage Computation
modules.description: Implements the GRPO-style group sampling mechanism that generates G candidate completions per prompt from the old policy, and computes group-relative advantages by subtracting the group mean reward from each sample's reward, eliminating the need for a learned value function.

modules.name: Variance Reduction: Antithetic Sampling & Coupled Sampling
modules.description: Implements two variance reduction strategies for ELBO estimation: (1) antithetic sampling through mask sharing, which uses identical timesteps and mask positions when computing ELBO differences between policies to induce negative correlation; (2) coupled sampling with complementary masking, which partitions the token set into complementary mask pairs and averages their losses so every token contributes at least once.

modules.name: Multi-Task Data Preprocessing & Formatting
modules.description: Handles data preprocessing for the three task categories: mathematics (GSM8K, MATH training splits), coding (AceCoder-87K subset), and planning (synthetic Countdown and Sudoku data). Includes prompt template construction (d1-style and Dream-style for Sudoku), format conversion for different dLLM backbones, and length-specific truncation/padding.

modules.name: Custom Dataset & DataLoader for RL Rollouts
modules.description: Manages the RL training data pipeline including prompt batching, rollout buffer management for storing old policy samples and their rewards, group-based sampling ensuring G completions per prompt are generated together, and batch size configuration per task difficulty.

modules.name: dLLM Denoising & Inference Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the non-autoregressive denoising inference for masked diffusion models, supporting model-specific strategies: LLaDA (low-confidence sampling with semi-autoregressive block decoding) and Dream (top negative entropy remasking with pure diffusion sampling). Configurable denoising steps, temperature scheduling (training vs. evaluation), and unmasking rate control.

modules.name: Reward Computation for Multiple Task Types
modules.description: Implements task-specific reward functions: exact-match verification for mathematics, test-case execution for coding (HumanEval/MBPP pass/fail), constraint satisfaction for Countdown (arithmetic expression evaluation), and Sudoku rule compliance checking (row/column/box uniqueness). Supports both sparse binary rewards and partial credit where applicable.

modules.name: Training Loop & Policy Update Controller
modules.description: Orchestrates the full ESPO training loop alternating between data generation (sampling from old policy) and policy updates. Manages the policy update value mu controlling the number of optimization steps per data collection phase, gradient accumulation for effective batch sizes, and checkpoint evaluation at convergence.

modules.name: Evaluation Suite for Math, Coding & Planning
modules.description: Evaluates model performance across all benchmarks at multiple generation lengths (128, 256, 512). Computes accuracy for GSM8K/MATH, pass rates for HumanEval/MBPP and their EvalPlus variants, and success rates for Countdown/Sudoku. Uses task-specific evaluation scripts from LLaDA/Dream repositories and supports both d1-style and Dream-style Sudoku evaluation.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Supports controlled ablation experiments comparing: (1) action space (token-level vs. sequence-level), (2) likelihood approximation (mean-field vs. ELBO), (3) KL estimators (k1 vs. k2 vs. k3), (4) number of Monte Carlo samples (1, 2, 4), (5) policy update values (8, 12, 24, 48, 72). Tracks reward curves, KL estimates, and gradient norms for each configuration.

modules.name: Computational Cost Analysis
modules.description: Computes theoretical FLOPs for dLLM RL training decomposed into generation cost (K forward passes) and policy update cost (mu * M forward-backward passes), accounting for coupled sampling doubling. Validates theoretical estimates against empirical wall-clock time on target hardware across different MC sample counts.

modules.name: Configuration, Logging & Experiment Management
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations including per-task hyperparameters (LoRA vs. full fine-tuning, learning rates, batch sizes, group sizes), training logs with TensorBoard/Wandb integration tracking rewards, KL divergence, gradient norms, and model checkpointing. Supports reproducibility with seeded runs and result aggregation for automated table generation.
